_note: Signet Jam, the jam-night pitch page. A PRIVATE SHARE: Daniel sends the link after a first conversation with a venue owner, so it is linked from no nav and no footer, and the noindex keeps it out of the sitemap, llms.txt and search. ?venue=Name personalises the venue line and the tab title (textContent only); ?motion=off renders the plain stack. REBUILT 2026-09-18 on Daniel's call ('if someone comes to this page they're not going to know what's going on'): the page now explains itself from zero, in this order: what a jam night is (hero lede), what it does for a taproom, the deal (venue cost, Signet's side, the twelve-week term), how the night runs, who's running it, the site's client strip, seven owner questions, the close. The ledger lines, the twelve-week line, the host paragraph and 'One venue. Sunday or Monday.' are the 2026-09-16 handoff's; the rest is 2026-09-18 copy written to the copy laws (AI-TELLS, no o'clocks, no projections, no scene-writing, no prices, 'musicians' never 'players'). Two readings of the handoff were flagged to Daniel in the handback and stand until he strikes them: 'No fee' for the venue in the first twelve weeks, and the band's own PA as Signet's sound. Never put a venue name in a link handed to him. Page-scoped CSS lives in sections/00-style.html, the script in sections/08-script.html. The original handoff is HANDOFF.md in this dir; nothing in it is ratified voice, see the 2026-09-16 note.
title: Signet Jam
meta_description: A weekly jam night at one Denver taproom on a Sunday or Monday, run by a professional house band with a sign-up sheet. Twelve weeks to start, then we both decide.
